bus.via: Downtown Dallas / Deep Ellum to Fort Worth Downtown

trips.route_note: Take the Trinity Railway Express (TRE) commuter train from Dallas Union Station or Victory Station directly to Fort Worth's T&P Station or Fort Worth Central, about an hour with no changes.
see: Fort Worth Stockyards and cattle drive
trips.tour_query: Fort Worth day trip from Dallas
trips.why: The TRE commuter train runs direct from Dallas to central Fort Worth in about an hour with no changes.
know: Fort Worth's Stockyards and Cultural District are the main draws
TRE does not run on Sundays
Check the last train back before an evening out

bus.via: Downtown Dallas / Deep Ellum to Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport

trips.route_note: Take the Trinity Railway Express from Dallas to the Grapevine-Main Street station, then a short walk or local shuttle into the historic downtown; no changes needed on the train.
trips.why: A 40-minute bus ride beats the train-plus-walk combo and drops you near the historic downtown.
know: Historic downtown and winery tasting rooms are the highlights
Weekend services can be limited, so check times ahead
Autumn's GrapeFest is the busiest time to visit

train.via: Trinity Mills Station to Downtown Denton Transit Center

bus.via: Downtown Dallas / Deep Ellum to Denton

trips.route_note: Take the DCTA A-train from Dallas via a connection at Trinity Mills (DART Green Line) to downtown Denton, or a direct regional bus; the A-train terminates at Downtown Denton station.
trips.why: The direct regional bus is faster than the two-leg A-train route and needs no connection.
know: The downtown square and university campus are the main sights
A-train connections via Trinity Mills add time
Check return times, as evening services are sparse
